anyOf.description: Empty object kept when the command fails before assigning data.

name.description: The full command name, space-separated for a command in a group.

group.description: The group the command belongs to; absent for a top-level command.

network.description: True when the command may make network calls.

reads_project.description: True when the command reads haiven.toml.

title: haiven help data
description: Command payload, or an empty object when the command fails before it assigns data. An empty object is not a successful payload.
